subject.title: fix(reef): bound legacy state file reads in doctor migration

question: For oversized valid Reef legacy state, should Doctor incrementally migrate the data, or may it fail with a documented recovery path that preserves user history?
rationale: The correct fix depends on the product contract for persistent legacy audit and replay history; the current hard failure silently chooses a data-availability policy without maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Stream and migrate records
options.body: Implement a bounded incremental reader/import path so large valid JSONL history migrates without a full-file allocation.

options.title: Retain a hard limit with recovery
options.body: Keep an explicit cap only if maintainers define and document a safe export, recovery, or repair flow for oversized persistent state.

recommendation.title: Stream and migrate records
recommendation.body: Implement a bounded incremental reader/import path so large valid JSONL history migrates without a full-file allocation.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the available implementation contact for the current patch, while feature-history ownership could not be established from the supplied evidence.
